title: Rail Fast Checkout — Delegated Purchase Supplement
purpose: Short delegated-purchase supplement to rail-booking; host presentation differences only.
when_to_use: The buyer delegated railway selection and a current bookable result is available. Read rail-booking first.

steps.command: Use the rail-booking guide already read for this request
notes: Use the current query result and booking_template; this topic does not replace the railway guide.

Before first querying, follow the single endpoint-understanding brief in rail-booking (meaning/category/evidence/unknowns and Exact/Smart choice). Use reliable route knowledge or one short lookup if merely probable. With current results, continue from their facts; do not restart to backfill a brief.

steps.command: Use the current result’s booking_template and returned next action
notes: Select under the buyer’s unchanged rules. Required human terms still require real consent. Continue the same booking execution.

Copy the complete plan template into one booking; raw legs are single-leg compatibility only, multi-leg purchases require the complete selections template; one whole quote and official payment entry, separate issuance. Use the returned full review JSON; only missing real agreement requires asking.
Show only the supported official entry. Read itpay order <order_id> --json after payment for authoritative status; issuing is not issued.

never: Never invent consent, identity or a seat code.
Never duplicate a purchase or repeat an unknown-outcome payment.
Never show an internal command to the human.

When a failure has no applicable next, interaction, recovery or complete new-query template, stop; never guess undeclared fields, duplicate a booking, split a journey into separate payments or claim an unverified cause.
